pr_title: SQL: Add method args to PERCENTILE/PERCENTILE_RANK
pr_body:
* Adds the capability to have functions with two optional arguments
* Adds two new optional arguments to `PERCENTILE()` and
  `PERCENTILE_RANK()` functions, namely the method and
  method_parameter which can be: 1) `tdigest` and a double `compression`
  parameter or 2) `hdr` and an integer representing the
  `number_of_digits` parameter.
* Integration tests
* Documentation updates

Closes #63567

issue_context.title: SQL: hdr histogram parameter (hdr_digits) missing for percentile and percentile_rank function
issue_context.body:
Elastic SQL does not support the [hdr histrogram parameter](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/search-aggregations-metrics-percentile-aggregation.html#_hdr_histogram) currently, which is available for the dsl query format and massively speeds up the query (I get timeouts when using the percentile-aggregation functions with the dsl query language without this parameter). 

Possible implementation syntax for the sql function:

percentile(field, percentile[, hdr_digits]) 
percentile_rank(field, percentile[, hdr_digits]) 

```
POST _sql
{"query":"select percentile(\"myfield\", 95, 3) from \"myindex\" where timestamp > 'now-5m' and timestamp < 'now/m'"}

POST _sql
{"query":"select percentile_rank(\"myfield\", 95, 2) from \"myindex\" where timestamp > 'now-5m' and timestamp < 'now/m'"}
```

review_comments: A small nit - to avoid having two constructors, it would be possible make the base class public so that percentilesConfig can be accessed. Since the rest of the methods are not, it keeps the encapsulation while removing redundancy.
Extract the children extraction the `if`s above - it's easier to understand what branch did what.
